nodes.description: owner: privileged address, set in constructor to msg.sender and read in onlyOwner/onlyOwnerOrBankroll modifiers
bankroll: address authorized to receive dividends and act as house; used in onlyBankroll modifier
contractBalance: accounting of ZTH tokens held; incremented on spin, decremented on payout
gameActive: boolean gate controlling whether spins are permitted
playerSpins mapping: per-player pending spin struct (token value + block number)
validTokenBet mapping: whitelist of permitted wager sizes
totalSpins: counter of all spins executed
totalZTHWagered: cumulative tokens wagered
ZTHTKN: ZTHInterface instance used to transfer reward tokens
ZTHTKNADDR: trusted ZTH token contract address used for token origin validation
ZTHBANKROLL: constructor-supplied bankroll address stored at deploy time
constructor: initializes owner, bankroll, token interfaces, bet whitelist and gameActive
fallback payable: accepts plain ether transfers
tokenFallback: ERC223 callback bundling incoming tokens into a TKN struct and forwarding to _spinTokens
_spinTokens: validates sender/wager, records pending spin, settles previous spin, updates counters
finishSpin: public entry point settling the caller's pending spin
_finishSpin: resolves random result, computes payout, transfers tokens and clears player state
jackpotGuard: verifies max potential payout is at most half of contractBalance
maxRandom: derives entropy from blockhash(blockn) and address entropy
random: returns maxRandom(...) modulo upper
balanceOf: view returning contractBalance
addNewBetAmount: owner-only whitelisting of a new wager size
pauseGame: owner-only function disabling spins
resumeGame: owner-only function re-enabling spins
changeOwner: owner-only ownership transfer
changeBankroll: owner-only bankroll update
divertDividendsToBankroll: owner-only ether sweep to bankroll
testingSelfDestruct: owner-only token recovery and contract destruction
_zthToken: private view confirming the token caller equals the trusted ZTH address
msg.sender: caller-controlled address driving access-control checks and spin ownership
ZTHTKN.transfer(target, profit): external token transfer executed before player state is cleared
selfdestruct(owner): destroys contract and forwards balance to owner
bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance): external ether transfer to bankroll
_from: token origin address supplied to tokenFallback
_value: token amount supplied to tokenFallback
_tkn: TKN memory struct built inside tokenFallback
_tkn: TKN struct parameter of _spinTokens
spin: memory copy of playerSpins rewritten and stored in _spinTokens
_customerAddress: local alias of _tkn.sender
_wagered: local alias of _tkn.value used for accounting
target: address whose pending spin is settled in _finishSpin
spin: memory copy of playerSpins[target] read in _finishSpin
profit: payout amount computed in _finishSpin
result: random draw determining win/loss in _finishSpin
_wager: proposed wager size checked by jackpotGuard
maxProfit: _wager multiplied by 25 in jackpotGuard
halfContractBalance: contractBalance divided by 2 in jackpotGuard
blockn: block number whose hash seeds maxRandom
entropy: address mixed into maxRandom keccak256
upper: modulo bound for the random helper
blockn: block number forwarded to maxRandom
entropy: address forwarded to maxRandom
_tokenAmount: new wager size whitelisted by addNewBetAmount
_newOwner: replacement owner address in changeOwner
_newBankroll: replacement bankroll address in changeBankroll
ZethrAddress: trusted token contract passed to the constructor
BankrollAddress: bankroll address passed to the constructor
_tokenContract: address tested against ZTHTKNADDR in _zthToken
